prompt_en: Create a cinematic fashion photograph inside a compact commercial-aircraft lavatory. An unmistakably adult female flight attendant wears a tailored navy cabin uniform with a fitted blazer, crisp blouse, neck scarf, and short structured skirt. She steadies herself beside the tiny sink during a gentle bank, one knee bent and her weight shifted naturally, while glancing at her reflection with calm professional composure. Use a waist-to-knee composition that makes her thighs the dominant foreground form. Let a narrow mirror sliver repeat only her shoulder and scarf; the single-subject hierarchy stays clear while the cramped curved panels, latch, folded paper towels, and brushed-metal fixtures form layered depth. Restrict the palette to navy, pearl gray, and muted amber. Cool overhead cabin light mixes with a soft warm mirror glow, creating realistic skin texture and restrained highlights on fabric. Shoot at close range with a 35 mm documentary-fashion perspective, slight diagonal geometry, shallow but credible depth of field, fine grain, and polished magazine realism. The image feels intimate, poised, and subtly sensual, with believable proportions and gentle aircraft vibration.
negative_en: illustration look, low resolution, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, body distortion, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, cartoon style
